pages.course:
Movement I · 8 weeks

Piano from Zero

No keyboard? A phone and a table are enough for week one. By week eight you will play a short piece, hands together.

Enrol · RM 79/moFree lesson

Weeks 1–2 · Finding your way

Posture, the keyboard layout, right-hand five-finger positions.

Weeks 3–4 · Left hand and reading

Bass notes, simple rhythms, your first lead sheet.

Weeks 5–6 · Hands together

Slow, steady, correct. Short exercises with the metronome.

Weeks 7–8 · Your first piece

Ode to Joy, arranged for small hands.

pages.faq:
Home/FAQ

FAQ

Do I need a real piano?

A 61-key keyboard is enough. Start with the on-page keyboard if you don't have one yet.

Am I too old to start?

Our oldest beginner was 78. Our average is 41.

Can I learn to read music?

Yes. Movement II is dedicated to it.
